anthropic.name: Anthrophic
anthropic.description: Provides access to the Claude family of models
anthropic.content: [Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com/) provides access to the Claude family of models. You can connect to Anthropic via [proxy inference](/docs/quickstart) or by using your own API key with a third party harness like [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) and the [Compeer CLI](/docs/cli).

claude-code.name: Claude Code
claude-code.content: [Claude Code](https://claude.com/product/claude-code) is Anthropic's agentic coding assistant. Use the [Compeer CLI](/docs/cli) to initialize Compeer in your project, pick a workspace, and select Claude Code as your harness. Now, Claude Code can search context stored in Compeer. You can also integrate Compeer via [mcp](/docs/mcp-servers).

entra.name: Microsoft Entra ID
entra.description: Microsoft's cloud identity and access management service
entra.content: [Microsoft Entra ID](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/business/identity-access/microsoft-entra-id) is a cloud identity and access management service. You can use it as an OIDC provider to authenticate users in your Compeer deployment.

google.name: Google
google.content: [Google](https://cloud.google.com/identity-platform) provides OIDC identity services. Use Google as an OIDC provider to authenticate users in your Compeer deployment.

keycloak.name: Keycloak
keycloak.content: [Keycloak](https://www.keycloak.org/) is an open-source identity and access management solution. You can use Keycloak as an OIDC provider to authenticate users in your Compeer deployment.

authelia.name: Authelia
authelia.content: [Authelia](https://www.authelia.com/) is an open-source authentication and authorization server. You can use Authelia as an OIDC provider to authenticate users in your Compeer deployment.

authentik.name: Authentik
authentik.content: [Authentik](https://goauthentik.io/) is an open-source identity provider. You can use Authentik as an OIDC provider to authenticate users in your Compeer deployment.

cloudflare.name: Cloudflare
cloudflare.content: [Cloudflare](https://www.cloudflare.com/) provides a global cloud platform. You can deploy Compeer as a Docker image on Cloudflare.

railway.name: Railway
railway.content: [Railway](https://railway.com/) is a modern application deployment platform. You can deploy Compeer as a Docker image on Railway.

fly-io.name: Fly.io

fly-io.content: [Fly.io](https://fly.io/) is an application deployment platform. You can deploy Compeer as a Docker image on Fly.io.
